projects.title: LogPulse — Automated OSS/BSS Log Triage & RCA Platform
projects.subtitle: Sub-second root cause classification and automated Jira RCA ticket generation
projects.desc: Architected and deployed an automated Root Cause Analysis (RCA) triage platform designed to eliminate manual log analysis bottlenecks across complex OSS/BSS order-to-activate (O2A) pipelines and CRM integrations. Engineered a high-throughput Python/FastAPI backend with sub-second Groq LLM inference to parse unstructured logs, extract diagnostic error signatures, and classify failures across a 5-part telecom error taxonomy (OrderEngine task sequencing, DSLAM node provisioning, CRM-OSS state transition blocks, and ISAP/OFM API integration errors). Enforced a self-policing <70% confidence threshold for human review, automated Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) runbook command generation, and built 1-click Jira/ServiceNow ticket formatters backed by 99 automated test fences — reducing incident diagnosis time from ~20 minutes to under 1 second with 95%+ classification accuracy.
